derivation_notes.contract_volume: volume_fp, volume_24h_fp, and open_interest_fp are contract-count fields (fixed-point contract counts), not traded-dollar volume. notional_value_dollars is the value of a single contract at settlement, not cumulative turnover.
derivation_notes.sampled_yes_price_times_contracts: Computed arithmetic: SUM(yes_price_dollars * count_fp) over valid rows returned by GET /markets/trades (up to 3 pages x limit 1000). No min_ts time bound is passed; pagination is capped. Missing/invalid prices or counts are skipped. This sample product is not asserted as actual all-side cash turnover, gross cash exchanged, full-history activity, or a complete 24-hour total; only tickers with valid returned rows receive a value.
derivation_notes.sampled_trade_contracts_fp: SUM(count_fp) for valid rows in the market's returned trade sample; not complete volume.
derivation_notes.sampled_trade_count: Number of valid returned trade records for the market; not contract quantity or complete history.
derivation_notes.sampled_last_trade_time: Latest created_time among valid trade rows returned for the market; not necessarily the latest market trade.
derivation_notes.ranking: events/markets sorted by volume_24h_fp desc, then volume_fp desc (contract volume, not dollar volume).
derivation_notes.topic_rules: Discovery uses only official Kalshi `category` / `tags` filters. Where no category covers a topic (retail gasoline), the same explicit series-family + title rule and exclusions as the dashboard (assets/js/config.js) are applied locally; they can only narrow the official candidate list, never add to it.
